note: The golden conversation of the switch eval: Claude, then Codex, then Claude. Each fact is said once in a turn; each question can be answered only from the turn named in `from`.

turns.say: We are building the Northwind Bakery site.
The launch date is March 14, and that is fixed.
We host on Railway, in the Oregon region.
The monthly budget is 4,200 dollars, no more.
The designer is Priya Raman, and she signs off on every page.
Do not use the blue palette anywhere.

questions.ask: Which bakery is the site for?
Is the launch date fixed or open?
Which region is the host in?
Who signs off on the pages?
questions.needle: she signs off on every page
